content.title: Lamar Odom to reveal what he saw in the afterlife in Netflix doc
content.text: NewsLamar Odom opens up about seeing what he calls the afterlife after his 2015 drug overdose, a moment he says changed his life and will be shared in his new Netflix documentary.(Photo by Richard Shotwell/Invision/AP)Richard Shotwell/Invision/APNEW YORK — Former NBA star Lamar Odom says he saw the afterlife after nearly dying from a drug overdose in 2015. He discusses this experience in the new Netflix documentary “The Death & Life of Lamar Odom.” Odom says what he saw was very different from what many people think the afterlife is like. Odom used to play professional basketball, mostly with the Los Angeles Lakers. In October 2015, he was found unresponsive in a brothel near Las Vegas after taking drugs. Doctors said he had 12 strokes and six heart attacks. They placed him in a medically induced coma. He later woke up and began a long recovery. In the trailer for the Netflix documentary, Odom says the afterlife was not what he had expected. The documentary shows parts of the 911 call and footage about the night Odom nearly died. It also has interviews with people who were close to him, including his ex-wife Khloé Kardashian. She talks about the struggles they faced during their marriage, especially his problems with drugs. She also talked about how hard it was to help Odom while he was struggling. She says she felt responsible for protecting him Odom has been open about his addiction in the past, and he says the near-death experience changed how he thinks about life. He has been sober and working on his health in the years since the overdose. The film, part of Netflix’s “Untold” series, will be released on March 31.
